description: MainActivity.kt defines the main screen of an Android notes app. It manages creating, editing, deleting, searching, and displaying notes, including UI components like RecyclerView, dialogs, and tags.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main screen activity for the notes app, handling UI, note operations, and interactions.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying notes in list or grid format.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI components, listeners, demo notes.

methods.name: refreshTagBar
methods.description: Updates the tag filter bar based on current notes.

methods.name: updateGridLayout
methods.description: Sets RecyclerView layout manager based on grid toggle.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters notes based on search query and selected tag.

methods.name: showNoteDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed view of a selected note.

methods.name: showList
methods.description: Shows the main list view, hiding detail view.

methods.name: showNoteOptions
methods.description: Shows options to edit or delete a note.

methods.name: showNoteDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog for creating or editing a note.
